**Please note: The original proposal included only 4 Milestones, with the total of 40 articles (etc etc) split evenly across 4 milestones - 40 per milestone. Due to requirements of the Milestone module, we were forced to organize our project into FIVE milestones instead of 4. (I wished to keep it at 4 as written in the proposal, but after a back-and-forth with Catalyst support, 5 milestones was the only option available for a 12 month project as this is) So to make the exact same outputs fit into 5 milestones instead of 4, we had to toggle the numbers around. Now it is 5 milestones x 8 articles per milestone, instead of 4 milestones x 10 articles. The total is 40 articles either way 4x10 = 5x8. Similar adjustments were made to the spread of other outputs, with the total number of outputs in each category remaining the SAME in every case as the original proposal.

・8 articles reflect ongoing quality, hype-free educations aligned with current content on the site

・Ui/UX design meets the needs of users to navigate and use the new tools
・Reviewers and the general public can use the new tools to access free NFTs and they can participate in the grassroots marketing program if they desire!
